The problem

How to compare apartment marketing agencies in Phoenix

01Ask for Valley proof: a Phoenix area community they market, with leasing numbers from before and after.
02Ask who does the work. A small team that writes your posts and replies to your reviews knows your community better than an account queue.
03Ask how often you get a report, and what is in it. Calls, direction requests and website clicks from your Google listing tell you what renters actually did.
04Ask about Google Business Profile and reviews. That listing is often the first thing a renter sees when searching apartments in Phoenix.
05Ask about AI search. Renters now ask ChatGPT and Google's AI where to live, so ask what the agency does to help your community come up in those answers.
